classDefinitions.gate: Fails a build/lint/publish step (or is designed to) with a fail-closed exit code — blocks CI, release, or sprint admission on violation.
classDefinitions.recurring-proof: A repeatable proof/audit/measurement harness (smoke, verify, audit) proving real end-to-end behavior; rerun on demand, does not itself block CI unless explicitly wired as a gate.
classDefinitions.admin-migration: A data-repair or repo-migration tool run by an operator against durable state (memory.db, another repo) — not part of any automated pipeline.
classDefinitions.one-shot: A manually invoked utility (dev tool, report generator, sync helper) with no CI/gate role and no migration semantics.
classDefinitions.retired: No longer used / superseded; kept only for historical reference. (No current scripts/*.mjs file qualifies as of 2026-08-11 — see notes on sync-to-product.mjs and zero-hardcode-audit.mjs for the closest borderline cases, neither of which is dead.)
